actions.code: (()=>{const A=RS.Audio; const an=A.ctx.createAnalyser(); an.fftSize=2048; A.master.connect(an); window._rms=()=>{const d=new Float32Array(an.fftSize); an.getFloatTimeDomainData(d); let s=0; for(const v of d) s+=v*v; return Math.sqrt(s/d.length);}; window._peak=async(ms)=>{let m=0; const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20)); m=Math.max(m,_rms());} return m;}; const S=RS.Save.data.settings; S.sfx=false; S.ambient=false; S.music=true; A.applySettings(); return JSON.stringify({unlocked:A.unlocked, state:A.ctx.state, track:A.curName});})()

(async()=>{const S=RS.Save.data.settings; S.sfx=true; RS.Audio.applySettings(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); RS.Audio.sfx('coins'); return 'sfx with music off rms='+(await _peak(400)).toFixed(4);})()
